title: MMLU-CF: A Contamination-free Multi-task Language Understanding Benchmark
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion. While model performance is broken down by discipline in the appendix (including Philosophy), the authors do not analyze or draw any conclusions specifically about religion, faith, or theological reasoning.

measurement_description: The benchmark, MMLU-CF, measures general world knowledge across 14 disciplines. One of these disciplines is 'Philosophy', which includes questions that can touch upon religious concepts. For example, one sample question differentiates between a 'religious judgement' and other types of judgements. However, the benchmark does not specifically measure religious knowledge, theological understanding, or bias related to faith.
